result.summary: Root cause CONFIRMED at DDL-log level: tools/clean_test_db.py's orphan sweep runs concurrently with the test binaries (build.zig:1304-1307 declares clean_test_db.step and the two run_* steps as unordered SIBLINGS of test_integration_tnt_step) and issues DROP SCHEMA <tenant_uuid> CASCADE (clean_test_db.py:119) against a schema that a running test is actively migrating, plus DELETE of its ledger rows (line 123). runForSchema then hits 42P01 on the next file doing unqualified work. Server log caught backend 57413 dropping tenant_37630918ade942288be9157ced6f296e at 09:46:46.691 while migration-runner backend 57140 was mid-migration-081 on it at 09:46:46.972. Control: zig build test-integration-tnt 5/5 FAIL vs the SAME test.exe run directly 6/6 PASS. Prior hypotheses (stale `applied` snapshot, search_path clobber across COMMIT, GBL-133 ledger backfill) all REFUTED by instrumentation; the accompanying C23505 on 001_event_store.sql is TC-TNT-02-05's intentional duplicate-insert assertion and appears in passing runs too. No source fix applied; temporary instrumentation removed (clean git diff, zig build exits 0); db_test log_statement reset.
